book: Physics Practical Journal - Class X (Sindh Textbook Board)
calibration: The source XML declares 10/15/18-metre widths. Scene overrides provisionally use 0.10/0.15/0.18 metres for book diagrams. Measure the actual printed target crop before hardware calibration; resized prints and screen images need their own width.

experiments.Title: Refraction through a glass slab
Steps: Trace the glass slab and draw an incident ray
Place two pins along the incident ray
Align two emergent pins; trace the refracted ray
Measure i and r; compare sin i / sin r

experiments.Title: Refractive index of water with a concave mirror
Steps: Place the concave mirror horizontally
Adjust the needle until its image has no parallax
Add water; find the new no-parallax position
Compare the real and apparent radii of curvature

experiments.Title: Critical angle of glass
Steps: Trace the prism and mark a normal
Send a ray into the glass through the first face
Adjust until the emergent ray grazes the surface
Measure the critical angle inside the glass

experiments.Title: Deviation of light through a prism
Steps: Trace the triangular prism and an incident ray
Align pins with the emergent ray
Draw the refracted path and measure deviation
Repeat at different angles; find minimum deviation

experiments.Title: Focal length of a convex lens by parallax
Steps: Place the lens and object pin on a scale
Move the search pin to the image position
Remove parallax between the image and search pin
Measure p and q; calculate f = p q / (p + q)

experiments.Title: Astronomical telescope
Steps: Choose a long-focus objective and short-focus eyepiece
Align both lenses on a common axis
Adjust their separation to focus a distant object
Compare magnification with f objective / f eyepiece

experiments.Title: Compound microscope
Steps: Place a small object on the microscope stage
Focus the short-focus objective near the object
Adjust the eyepiece to view the intermediate image
Observe the enlarged final image

experiments.Title: Verify Ohm's law
Steps: Connect the ammeter in series with the resistance
Connect the voltmeter across the resistance
Close the key; vary current with the rheostat
Record V and I; check that V / I stays constant

experiments.Title: Resistors in series
Steps: Connect the two resistors in one series path
Place the ammeter in series and voltmeter across both
Close the key and record voltage and current
Compare V / I with R1 + R2

experiments.Title: Resistors in parallel
Steps: Connect the resistors across the same two nodes
Apply the same voltage to all branches
Observe current splitting between the branches

experiments.Title: Galvanometer resistance by half deflection
Steps: Connect a high series resistance and galvanometer
Close the main key and note the deflection
Close the shunt key; adjust for half deflection
Use the series and shunt resistances to calculate G

experiments.Title: Magnetic field of a bar magnet
Steps: Place a bar magnet on a sheet of paper
Place the plotting compass near its north pole
Mark successive compass directions around the magnet
Trace field lines from north to south outside the magnet
